items.title: Product of the Day — Alive Coffee
items.content_text:
Alive Coffee is a specially cultivated blend infused with microscopic organisms that stimulate coffee plants during photosynthesis, resulting in an unparalleled flavor profile and intoxicating aroma. As consumers drink Alive Coffee, these microorganisms adapt to their individual metabolisms, subtly altering taste notes over time to match personal preferences.

As the coffee is consumed, it's said to induce temporary empathy towards fellow sippers within earshot, fostering impromptu friendships among strangers who share a cup.

Categories: food

items.title: Product of the Day — Doomsday Waffles
items.content_text:
The Doomsday Waffle is a specially formulated breakfast food designed to sustain individuals through catastrophic events. Its unique batter contains microencapsulated nutrients and adaptogenic herbs, allowing consumers to survive extreme conditions such as earthquakes, nuclear fallout, and zombie outbreaks. The crispy exterior provides added protection against radiation poisoning, while the fluffy interior helps regulate stress hormones during times of chaos.

As a bonus feature, when consumed near the end of civilization as we know it, the waffles will begin to release calming aromatics, reducing anxiety levels by up to 30%. They come individually packaged in durable, waterproof pouches containing enough sustenance for three days.

Categories: food

• 608 – Consecration of pope Boniface IV following his approval by the Byzantine emperor.
• 994 – Major Fatimid victory over the Byzantine Empire at the Battle of the Orontes.
• 1440 – Gilles de Rais, one of the earliest known serial killers, is taken into custody upon an accusation brought against him by Jean de Malestroit, Bishop of Nantes.

items.title: Dog Fact of the Day
items.content_text:
In Egypt, a person bitten by a rabid dog was encouraged to eat the roasted liver of a dog infected with rabies to avoid contracting the disease. The tooth of a dog infected with rabies would also be put in a band tied to the arm of the person bitten. The menstrual blood of a female dog was used for hair removal, while dog genitals were used for preventing the whitening of hair.

Picture: random.dog (https://random.dog/)
